protocol.validation_split: next sorted physical specimen cyclically; whole specimen
protocol.fit_weighting: equal physical specimen; equal extraction within each physical specimen
protocol.affine_fit: weighted least squares on fitting specimens only
protocol.epoch_selection: minimum whole-validation-specimen normalized coordinate MSE; epoch zero eligible
protocol.primary_metric: equal-specimen mean normalized coordinate RMSE, averaged across fixed seeds
protocol.secondary_metric: equal-specimen mean pixel coordinate RMSE; camera scale dependent
protocol.label_warning: Automated image-derived tracks are noisy supervision, not DIC/FEM ground truth.
protocol.independence_warning: Extractions, frames, nodes and optimizer seeds are not independent experiments.
protocol.generalization_warning: Known archived specimens extend the pilot; this is not a prospective locked external study.

augmentation.source: explicitly approved extra image-derived pseudo-labels; training only

zero_displacement.uncertainty_note: Optimizer seed variability only; no population confidence interval

phase_affine.uncertainty_note: Optimizer seed variability only; no population confidence interval

gnn.uncertainty_note: Optimizer seed variability only; no population confidence interval

mlp.uncertainty_note: Optimizer seed variability only; no population confidence interval

final_demonstration_model.epoch_rule: rounded median expanded LOSO validation-selected GNN epochs
final_demonstration_model.normalization: initial graph height; centered initial xy neural features
final_demonstration_model.warning: All admitted specimens used to fit this demonstration model; use outer-fold metrics for evaluation.
